title: Agent Identity / Continuity / Reputation Design Plan
description: A structured claim-set describing a proposed or existing identity->continuity->reputation design, in the shape reputation_soundness_audit.mjs audits for the chain-breaks named in the skill's Failure Modes table.

identityNonForgeable.description: True only if the agent id is minted by a trusted substrate (daemon/server) and bound to a credential the agent cannot cheaply re-pick. False if the agent can self-assert or choose its own id string.

continuityPersists.description: What the continuity mechanism actually persists across process/context death.

memory.description: An episodic record of what happened survives (e.g. episodic-memory-algorithms output).

checkpoint.description: A restorable execution/belief state survives, not just a text note.

outcomeLedger.description: An append-only, externally-witnessed record of what was delivered survives. Reputation keys on this field specifically.

outcomesCloseAgainstOracle.description: True only if outcomes close against ground truth the agent cannot author (merged SHA, passing test id, released claim, satisfied monitor) rather than free-text self-report.

sampledAdversarialAuditor.description: True if a random + risk-weighted fraction of cleared outcomes is re-opened and re-validated by an independent process.

estimator.description: The reputation estimator consolidating outcome/pairwise signal into a score. 'none' means no estimator exists yet.

representsUncertainty.description: True if the estimator represents calibrated uncertainty (e.g. TrueSkill variance) or budgets exploration (e.g. bandit exploration bonus), so a new backend/agent is neither trusted blindly nor starved.

scoreIsTelemetryGatesArePredicates.description: True if the learned scalar reputation score is exposed as telemetry only, and any kill/spend/routing gate is wired to concrete predicates instead (e.g. clean exits >= N, no open overdue obligations).

newcomerPolicy.description: True if a newcomer floor exists: full ability to work, reduced economic ceiling, until clean-exit history accrues. Absence risks whitewashing/Sybil-reset.

judge.description: Whether an LLM-as-judge is in the reputation loop, and whether it is de-biased.

present.description: True if any LLM-as-judge review participates in closing outcomes or scoring reputation.

deBiased.description: True if the judge is blinded, order-swapped/averaged, pairwise (not absolute), and excluded from judging its own family. Irrelevant (should be true or omitted-as-true) when present is false.

sanctionsStakedGraduated.description: True if sanctions for audit-failed/fake compliance are staked and graduated such that getting caught costs strictly more than honest non-completion.

notes.description: Free-text context for a human reviewer; not consumed by the auditor.
